text: The pager rotation for Godwit-4 is run by Soren Sandoval; alerts page them first.
Jolene Whitlock is on the pager rotation of Swift-8 this month, with a deputy as backup.
Unlike Kestrel-2, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Pipit-4 is the Tessera team. Nobody should assume the owner of Pipit-4 applies to Kestrel-2, the owner differs.
The rate limit of Godwit-4 is 3050 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.
Pages from Shrike-2 land on the pager rotation of Talia Marchetti before anyone else.

Unlike Merlin-5, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Swift-8 is 1500 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Swift-8 applies to Merlin-5, the rate limit differs.
The yearly budget for Merlin-5 is $3190k, covering licences and hosting.

Unlike Merlin-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Shrike-2 is Rust. Nobody should assume the language of Shrike-2 applies to Merlin-5, the language differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Pipit-4, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Godwit-4 is the Tallinn datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Godwit-4 applies to Pipit-4, the datacenter differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
